contentFull:
Wrapping up September: What’s new in the world of pigs?

From new feed and farm solutions to sustainability targets, technology and business investments, September brought a range of developments across the pig industry. Pig Progress rounds up some of the key business news and updates from September.

Natalie KinsleyFreelance journalist

Oct 1

News

Alltech and EnviroLogix integrate mycotoxin testing data into Rapiread

Alltech and EnviroLogix have partnered to integrate EnviroLogix mycotoxin test results directly into Alltech Rapiread, enabling customers to access testing data and risk analysis in one platform. The integration aims to simplify mycotoxin management and support faster, more informed feed quality and animal health decisions.

Premier Nutrition enhances Atlas to respond faster to raw material variation

Premier Nutrition has enhanced its Atlas online platform with a new tool that allows nutritionists to quickly model changes in raw material nutrient composition and assess their impact on pig and poultry diets. The functionality is designed to help nutritionists respond faster to seasonal variation in cereals, beans and other raw materials, supporting more precise formulation and nutrient management.

Novus launches soybean meal assessment service and new trace mineral

Novus has launched an Ingredient Assessment Service using NIR technology to estimate trypsin inhibitor levels in soybean meal, helping poultry and swine producers, nutritionists and feed manufacturers assess ingredient variability. The company has also introduced Relyzant, a bis-chelated trace mineral available in zinc, copper and manganese, which provides a concentrated source of organic trace minerals without methionine. 

Phodé launches new range of high-impact feed flavourings

Phodé Laboratories has launched Cristalfeed POP, a new range of feed flavourings designed to give feed formulations a distinctive sensory profile. The flavourings combine intensity, resistance and persistence and have been tested at a French centre specialising in feed manufacturing processes.

Roam Technology launches eco-conscious livestock cleaner

Roam Technology has launched Zix Eco Power, an alkaline foam cleaner designed to remove heavy soiling and organic matter from livestock facilities. The product contains no EDTA, phosphates or chlorine and is awaiting EU Ecolabel approval. A UK on-farm trial showed improved ATP cleanliness compared with 2 competing foam cleaners. 

Techna targets growth with €20 million investment plan

Techna is targeting growth under its CAP 2030 strategy, which aims to increase turnover from €100 million in 2025 to €130 million by 2030. The company plans to invest €20 million in production sites, international operations and staff, while expanding its precision nutrition and natural health activities.

Vion reports progress towards 2030 sustainability targets

Vion Food Group has reported progress towards its 2030 sustainability targets, including a 38.2% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions compared with 2021 and a 35.2% reduction in Scope 3 emissions. The company also increased the share of animals raised under certified higher-welfare standards to 23.3% and now has more than half of its Dutch workforce directly employed.

IFAJ and Alltech honour 10 young agricultural journalists

IFAJ and Alltech have recognised 10 young agricultural journalists through their 2026 Young Leaders in Agricultural Journalism Awards. The recipients from 10 countries attended a professional development programme and the IFAJ Congress in Croatia, where they had the opportunity to network with more than 200 agricultural journalists from around the world.
translationZh:
**Alltech与EnviroLogix将霉菌毒素检测数据整合至Rapiread**

Alltech与EnviroLogix达成合作，将EnviroLogix的霉菌毒素检测结果直接整合到Alltech Rapiread平台中，使客户能够在一个平台上访问检测数据和风险分析。该整合旨在简化霉菌毒素管理，支持更快、更明智的饲料质量和动物健康决策。

**Premier Nutrition增强Atlas平台以更快响应原料变化**

Premier Nutrition为其Atlas在线平台增强了一项新工具，使营养师能够快速模拟原料营养成分的变化，并评估其对猪和家禽日粮的影响。该功能旨在帮助营养师更快地应对谷物、豆类及其他原料的季节性变化，支持更精准的配方和营养管理。

**Novus推出大豆粕评估服务和新型微量元素**

Novus推出了一项利用NIR技术的原料评估服务，用于估算大豆粕中胰蛋白酶抑制剂的水平，帮助家禽和猪生产商、营养师及饲料制造商评估原料变异性。该公司还推出了Relyzant，一种双螯合微量元素，提供锌、铜和锰形式，可在不含蛋氨酸的情况下提供浓缩的有机微量元素来源。

**Phodé推出新型高效饲料调味剂系列**

Phodé Laboratories推出了Cristalfeed POP，这是一个新的饲料调味剂系列，旨在为饲料配方赋予独特的感官特征。这些调味剂结合了强度、耐受性和持久性，并已在法国一家专门从事饲料制造工艺的中心进行了测试。

**Roam Technology推出环保型畜牧清洁剂**

Roam Technology推出了Zix Eco Power，一种碱性泡沫清洁剂，旨在去除畜牧设施中的重度污垢和有机物。该产品不含EDTA、磷酸盐或氯，目前正在等待欧盟生态标签认证。英国的一项农场试验显示，与2种竞争性泡沫清洁剂相比，该产品的ATP清洁度有所改善。

**Techna以2000万欧元投资计划推动增长**

Techna正在其CAP 2030战略下推动增长，目标是将营业额从2025年的1亿欧元增加到2030年的1.3亿欧元。该公司计划投资2000万欧元用于生产基地、国际业务和员工，同时扩展其精准营养和天然健康业务。

**Vion报告2030年可持续发展目标进展**

Vion食品集团报告了其2030年可持续发展目标的进展，包括与2021年相比，范围1和范围2温室气体排放减少了38.2%，范围3排放减少了35.2%。该公司还将按照认证更高福利标准饲养的动物比例提高至23.3%，目前其荷兰员工中超过一半为直接雇佣。

**IFAJ与Alltech表彰10位青年农业记者**

IFAJ与Alltech通过其2026年农业新闻青年领袖奖表彰了10位青年农业记者。来自10个国家的获奖者参加了专业发展项目和在克罗地亚举行的IFAJ大会，在那里他们有机会与来自世界各地的200多名农业记者进行交流。
